parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) and `radioPlayerStopResetsStream` (line 53) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8181), they are deliberately distinct test cases verifying separate behavioural contracts of the radio player's stop operation — one asserting delegation to the underlying player, the other asserting stream reset. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and violate the single-assertion-per-test principle common in XCTest suites.
